displayName.ja: 【対魔忍アサギZERO】 井河　アサギ

profile.ja: 未成熟な中に大人びた雰囲気漂う。かなり希少な異能系の忍法“隼の術”を操るくノ一。名門井河家本流の嫡子として次代の対魔忍たちのリーダーになる事を期待されるも、対魔忍養成機関である五車学園への入学を拒否、曰く「政府の犬になるつもりはない」と一般の学校へ通っている。父・井河主膳（母・井河菊は幼少時に病没）はアサギが少女時代に対魔忍としての任務中に戦死、以後残された遺産を管理し、時にはアルバイトに励み独立して生活している。両親の死にあたり政府に対して強い不信感を持っている。 弱者を助け強者に挑むタイプ。言葉より先に実行する静かな理想家だが照れ屋でそれを悟られまいと偽悪的に振る舞う事も。一つ年下の妹さくらがいる。両親亡き後、さくらの保護者として父になり母になり育ててきた。妹思いで常に心配している。 得物は父の形見である忍者刀“悪鬼六文”。剣術“逸刀流”の免許皆伝の腕前だが、父の形見を悪の血で染める事を嫌い専ら格闘術を使う。忍者に伝わる格闘術“対魔殺法”その中でも足技による“刀脚”の使い手。彼女の忍法“隼の術”と組み合わせた刀脚は目に見えない超高速の蹴りのラッシュで敵を一瞬で粉砕するという。
profile.en: Igawa Asagi exudes a mature aura despite her youth. She is a kunoichi who wields the rare, ability-type ninjutsu "Haya no Jutsu." As the heir of the main line of the prestigious Igawa family, she is expected to become the next leader of the Taimanin, but she refused admission to Gosha Academy—the Taimanin training institute—saying, "I won't become the government's dog," and now attends a regular school. Her father, Igawa Shuzen (her mother, Igawa Kiku, died of illness in childhood), fell in battle while Asagi was still a girl on a Taimanin mission; since then she has managed his estate, sometimes taking part-time jobs to live independently. The loss of her parents has left her with a deep distrust of the government. She is the type who helps the weak and challenges the strong. A quiet idealist who acts before she speaks, she can act faux-malicious to hide her embarrassment. She has a younger sister, Sakura, for whom she has acted as both father and mother since their parents' death, and she constantly worries about her. Her weapon is the ninja sword "Akki Rokumon," a keepsake of her father. Though she has mastered the sword style "Itsutō-ryū," she dislikes staining her father's heirloom with evil blood and prefers to rely on hand-to-hand combat. She practices the ninja martial art "Taimashakuhō," specializing in foot techniques called "Tōkyaku." Combined with her "Haya no Jutsu," her Tōkyaku delivers an invisible, ultra-fast barrage of kicks that shatters enemies in an instant.

text.ja: 私は人魔外道の悪を滅する者、井河アサギ。政府の犬共と同じにしないことね
text.en: I am the one who eradicates the evil of humans and demons, Igawa Asagi. Don't treat me the same as the government's lapdogs.

text.ja: で？　何から手をつけていくわけ？
消極策で後手に回るのだけはやめてちょうだいよ
text.en: Please don't take a passive, wait-and-see approach.

text.ja: 思い切ってやればいいわ、私っていうサポートがあるんだから
text.en: Just go for it—you've got my support.

text.ja: 気を抜くことも大事よ、張り詰めて何かしでかす前にね
text.en: Relaxing is important too, before you get all tense and try to do something reckless.

text.ja: そういえば、お給料ってもらえるのよね？　ボーナスとかも
text.en: By the way, we do get paid, right? And bonuses too?

text.ja: 人魔外道は滅びるが定めよ。この私、井河アサギがいるかぎりね
text.en: Human demons will be eradicated—that's destiny. As long as I'm here, Igawa Asagi.

text.ja: 魂まで滅してあげる、人の世から消え失せなさい悪鬼羅刹ども
text.en: I'll wipe out your very souls—vanish from the human world, you vile demons!
